data.description: A scarecrow's touch infuses its target with overwhelming waves of fear.  If the victim fails a DC %1 Will sve, she cowers and can take no actions other than attempting a new DC %1 Will save at the end of the following round (and each round thereafter) to end this fear.  A successful first save leaves the victim shaken for 1 round.  This is a mind-affecting fear effect.
